verdict.rationale: Stripe's core webhook system (docs-38) lets developers subscribe to payment lifecycle events, and since Terminal payments use the same PaymentIntent/Charge objects, refunds (docs-28) and disputes (docs-40) events also fire and can be consumed via webhooks. However, evidence doesn't explicitly document Terminal-specific webhook payloads or event names tied to in-person transactions. Missing for 10: Terminal-specific webhook event documentation, hands-on confirmation that authorized/captured/refunded/disputed events fire identically for card-present Terminal transactions.
